events.title: 리버풀 effectively end 입스위치 타운's title challenge by beating them 2–1 at Anfield. 맨체스터 시티 crash to a 4–0 defeat at relegation-threatened 더비 카운티 and are now two points behind the Reds having played a game more. Meanwhile, half the clubs in the division remain in danger of relegation: 브리스틀 시티 are bottom, but just five points separate the ten teams immediately above them, with 토트넘 홋스퍼 in most danger, having played more games than their rivals.
